prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: final full-bleed architectural photograph for the SILENCE scene of INTERVAL, an original fictional coastal architecture experience.
Create one single finished landscape image, ideally 2560 x 1600 pixels, not a webpage, not a mockup. The viewpoint has arrived at an extraordinarily quiet open pavilion facing a calm sea. It belongs to a restrained contemporary coastal building made of warm grey board-formed concrete and pale natural limestone.
Composition: human eye-level camera, rectilinear architectural photography, perfectly vertical columns and a perfectly level horizon at roughly the vertical middle. A very thin, long warm concrete roof and its gently shaded soffit occupy only the upper 18–20 percent of the entire frame. One slender structural column stands near the far right edge, approximately 93 percent across the image, leaving the broad middle completely open. The foreground is an empty pale limestone platform with subtle large-scale joints that leads to the still water; it occupies approximately the bottom quarter. Architecture only frames the sky and sea. Beyond it, a delicate distant island silhouette and hazy coastal hills remain low and quiet. An expansive pale warm sky and calm silver-blue water create excellent soft negative space across the middle for a few words added later in code.
Light and mood: delicate natural morning sunlight from the upper left, soft warm highlights on limestone and concrete, believable soft shade under the roof, gently cool water, understated atmosphere, tranquil, tactile, precise. Light direction and surfaces should feel continuous with an earlier scene featuring a warm board-formed concrete monolith on a stone pathway over a reflecting pool beside a quiet rocky coast.
Surface realism: small aggregate and subtle timber-form impressions in concrete, fine limestone grain, realistic construction joints, gently moving water with restrained natural reflections, no dramatic waves. Highest-end architectural editorial photograph, carefully balanced exposure, refined natural color, extraordinary material detail, 40mm tilt-shift lens appearance, no exaggerated wide-angle distortion.
Constraints: original imaginary architecture, no imitation of a named or recognizable existing building. No people, furniture, signage, sculptures, boats, artificial lights, text, logo, watermark, page border, collage, panels, or decorative UI. No excessive dark areas, no black sky, no orange sunset, no fog hiding the architecture, no impossible unsupported roof. One serene coherent space, beautiful as a still photograph.
